records.question: 2014 年一共下了多少张订单?

records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country AS country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31' AND oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql: SELECT products.category AS category, ROUND(SUM(order_items.sales), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(order_items.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_cnt,
       COUNT(*) AS items_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS profit
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;

records.question: Consumer 类型的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customer_cnt DESC;

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(AVG(oi.discount),4) AS avg_discount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY avg_discount DESC;

records.question: 利润为负的亏损明细有多少行?

records.question: 数量小于等于 0 的异常明细有哪些行号?

SELECT oi.row_id, oi.order_id, o.order_date, oi.product_id, p.product_name, p.category, oi.sales, oi.quantity, oi.discount, oi.profit

records.question: 2013 年 3 月亚太市场有多少订单?

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS sales_total,
       COUNT(i.row_id) AS item_rows
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter;

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) IN ('2013', '2014') GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit)/SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin, COUNT(*) AS item_lines FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL AND oi.sales > 0 GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY profit_margin DESC

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, AVG(t.amt) AS avg_order_amt, MIN(t.amt) AS min_amt, MAX(t.amt) AS max_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN t.amt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_amt_orders FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(i.sales) AS amt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014' GROUP BY o.order_id) t

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales FROM ranked WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2);

records.question: 每种订单优先级各有多少张订单?

records.question: 总利润最高的 5 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT sub_category, ROUND(total_profit, 2) AS total_profit, item_rows
FROM (
  SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category,
         SUM(i.profit) AS total_profit,
         COUNT(*) AS item_rows
  FROM order_items AS i
  JOIN products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.sub_category
)
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

records.question: 各国家的总利润分别是多少?

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market AS market,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC

records.question: Technology 大类 2014 年的总销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014') AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE category = 'Technology');

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(AVG(oi.profit), 2) AS avg_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.profit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0 ORDER BY avg_profit;

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC;
